channel.title: Global Fastener News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Fastener News (globalfastenernews.com)

item.title: Dokka Fasteners Hires Infrastructure Accounts Manager
item.description: Steel industry veteran “brings strong insight into the Nordic infrastructure market and extensive experience in the sales of fasteners.”

item.title: Hilti Group Sales Slip in 2025
item.description: The Americas recorded strong growth of 9.3% during the year, while sales in Europe declined 1.9% and Middle East / Africa sales climbed 12.9%.

item.title: MW Components Hires HR Manager
item.description: Previously, new manager worked for PCI Pharma Services, Lowe’s Companies, and Pinnacle Logistics.

item.title: Century Fasteners Names GM of NE Sales
item.description: Fastener industry veteran joined Elmhurst, NY-based Birmingham Fastener in 2021.

item.title: Birmingham Fastener Launches Atlantic Fastener
item.description: Inventory at Greensboro, NC-based Atlantic Fastener includes anchor bolts manufactured to customer drawings, domestic hex head bolts with various coatings, and hard-to-find specialty fasteners.

item.title: Würth Industry USA Names Customers VP
item.description: Founded in 1969, Würth Industry USA supplies automotive chemicals, fasteners, hand tools and electrical supplies.

item.title: Simpson Mfg. Reports NA Volume Declines
item.description: Gross margin in North America decreased due to tariffs on certain imported fastener and anchor products, as well as higher factory and overhead and labor costs.

item.title: Howmet Reports Strong Fastener Revenue Growth
item.description: Fastening Systems revenue growth driven by a strong commercial aerospace market, partially offset by lower volumes in the commercial transportation market.

item.title: Nylon Fasteners Names Business/Operations Head
item.description: Connor Hurding joined UK-based Nylon Fasteners in 2021 as Operations Coordinator.

item.title: Randy Ladutko Retires from Supply Technologies
item.description: “I seriously doubt that many of us who are in this industry planned on it when we were young unless you were born into it... I grew up caddying for the president of a fastener division and needed a job out of college.”
